title: Hatchwatch
description: Hud for Cobblemon timers. Command to see past Cobblebreeding eggs hatched
body:
Hatchwatch — Never miss a hatch again!
A Cobbreeding companion mod that keeps you informed throughout the breeding process. Hatchwatch adds:
🥚 Hatch Notifications — get notified the moment your egg hatches, complete with species, shiny status, nature, and a color-coded IV breakdown so you can spot a great roll at a glance
📊 Hatch Log (/hatchlog) — track your breeding history with total hatches, shiny count, and your best IV roll ever, plus your 5 most recent hatches
⏱️ Live Egg Timer — a HUD display above your hotbar shows exactly how long until your egg hatches while you're holding it
Perfect for breeders grinding for shinies or perfect IVs who want to stay focused without constantly checking inventory.
